title: Regional response to potential US tariffs
subtitle: Council also backed a $150,000 grant toward a June 2025 eSports event in Waterloo Region.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting to act on recommendations from the Administration and Finance Committee and the closed committee earlier the same day.

The main decision responded to the possibility of a 25% United States tariff on Canadian goods as of March 2025. Council directed staff to explore ways to limit the impact on Regional services and to review procurement for opportunities to increase or require made-in-Canada provisions. It also asked the Waterloo Economic Development Corporation, through the Business Economic Support Team Waterloo Region, to develop an action plan supporting local businesses, including agricultural ones {{vote:m1}}. Manufacturing is a large part of the local economy, so tariffs could affect jobs and exports.

Council also approved a $150,000 grant from the Municipal Accommodation Tax Reserve fund to support Explore Waterloo Region's bid to host a major eSports event in June 2025 {{vote:m2}}. Routine by-law confirmation and adjournment followed.
